REPL command dispatch and provider/model wizards.

Handles all :cmd input that is not a prompt to the model. The command set is narrow by design: introspection (:show, :log, :tokens), context management (:clear, :summarize), provider/model switching (:provider, :model, :reasoning).

Tab-completion in tabComplete walks KnownGoodCombos and the live provider list to offer only valid model names. The provider-add wizard in runProviderAdd validates the API key with a one-token probe before saving.
